title: School Club Fair
audience: Chinese junior students (13-15 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A school club fair with three big club posters (Music/Art/Basketball), students demonstrating skills, and a sign-up table
imageDescription: A bright cartoon school club fair on a sunny day. A colorful triangular bunting banner across the top reads CLUB FAIR. Three large poster boards stand in a row. The left blue poster reads MUSIC CLUB with two small guitar pictures and the word FRIDAY on a white strip. The middle yellow poster reads ART CLUB with two paintbrushes and the word MONDAY on a white strip. The right green poster reads BASKETBALL CLUB with two basketballs and the word WEDNESDAY on a white strip. In front of the posters stand four students in blue school uniforms. On the left, a smiling boy plays a brown guitar. In the middle, a girl paints a landscape with green hills and a tree on an easel. On the right, a tall boy spins an orange basketball on one finger. In the foreground, a wooden table holds a small sign reading SIGN UP HERE, an open notebook with empty ruled lines and a pen, while a student leans over the table writing. Behind the fair are a school building, green trees and blue sky with white clouds.
scoringDescription: A bright cartoon school club fair on a sunny day under a blue sky with white clouds. Across the top, a colorful triangular bunting banner reads CLUB FAIR in big letters. Below stand three large vertical poster boards. Left: a blue poster titled MUSIC CLUB with two guitar pictures; a white strip under the title reads FRIDAY. Middle: a yellow poster titled ART CLUB with two paintbrush pictures; a white strip reads MONDAY. Right: a green poster titled BASKETBALL CLUB with two basketball pictures; a white strip reads WEDNESDAY. All poster text is in the upper half and fully visible. In front of the posters stand four students in blue sweaters, white shirts and ties. Left: a smiling brown-haired boy plays a brown guitar. Middle: a girl with a ponytail paints a landscape picture (green hills, one tree, blue sky with clouds) on a wooden easel, holding a brush. Right: a tall dark-haired boy spins an orange basketball on one finger. In the foreground, a wooden table carries a small tent sign reading SIGN UP HERE, an open notebook showing only empty ruled lines, and a blue pen; a fourth student leans over the notebook and writes. Behind the fair are a school building, green trees and lawns. Key facts: the Music Club meets on Friday, the Art Club on Monday, and the Basketball Club on Wednesday, so a student can join both the art and basketball clubs without a time conflict. The poster pictures match each club's activity: guitars for music, paintbrushes for art, basketballs for basketball. The students look happy and busy at the fair.
